name: Conradi-Hünermann-Happle症候群

summary.text: A rare genodermatosis disease with great phenotypic variation and characterized most commonly by ichthyosis following the lines of Blaschko, chondrodysplasia punctata (CDP), asymmetric shortening of the limbs, cataracts and short stature.
